t2.thesis: ABT enters a BMO print after a depressed 12-month run and three of the last four negative opening reactions, but with a cheap valuation and a large implied move, so the setup is roughly a coin flip with a slight tilt to the base rate.
reasons: BMO base rate is about 55%, while healthcare_growth is lower at 52%.
Last four prints: only 1 of 4 positive on the open, with large drops in Jan (-11.7%) and Apr (-3.6%), which suggests a history of disappointment on organic growth.
The stock is 18% below its 52-week high and trades at a forward P/E of 17, so expectations are low; the Q2 beat and guidance raise were followed by an +8.3% reaction.
The implied move of about 5.5% is high versus realized volatility, so the outcome is mostly symmetric and decided by the guidance.
Estimate revisions are flat (-0.2% over 90 days) and there is no clear edge from the options skew (call minus put IV is about 0).
t2.deciding_variable: Organic sales growth versus the 6.5-7.5% full-year guidance, especially Nutrition and Diagnostics, plus the Q4 and 2027 outlook including the Exact Sciences integration.

prior.from: BMO session base rate 0.548 (validation overall 0.542); healthcare_growth cluster 0.52

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. The date you're asking about (2026-10-21) is after today's date (2026-10-19), so that earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how ABT's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered from 0.55 to 0.50 for the weak recent earnings reaction history and the 0.52 healthcare cluster rate, offset by the low valuation and the positive 5-day and 1-month momentum.

theses.mechanism: Comparable sales growth accelerates as management promised for the second half, with Cologuard, electrophysiology and CGM strength, and the guidance is reaffirmed or raised from a depressed valuation.
theses.wrong_if: Comparable growth stays near 5% and the full-year sales guidance is trimmed.

theses.mechanism: Nutrition and rapid diagnostics remain weak, and margin dilution from Exact Sciences amortization and legal costs leads to a soft Q4 or 2027 outlook, repeating the January pattern.
theses.wrong_if: Nutrition stabilizes and Q4 guidance is above consensus.

theses.mechanism: An in-line EPS beat of about 1-2% with reaffirmed guidance leaves the open near the prior open, so the sign is essentially random.
theses.wrong_if: There is a surprise on guidance or a large segment miss or beat.

key_observations: Q3 comparable sales growth versus the roughly 6.5-7.5% full-year guide
Nutrition sales trend and the effect of pricing actions
Cancer Diagnostics (Cologuard) growth and Exact Sciences integration
Q4 EPS guide and full-year EPS range against $5.45-5.60
